title: Introduction to Sociology: Understanding Contemporary Society
description: Introduction to the study of contemporary society through the sociological lens. Topics may include gender, families, religion, ethnicity, education, social media, social determinants of health and environmental sociology.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 100B, SOCI 100.
recommendations: Recommend for students to first enrol in SOCI 100A, although SOCI 100A and SOCI 100B may be taken in either order or concurrently.
